title: Hazel and the Letter
author: M. M. Hartwell
blurb: Xanthe Crane, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
